# gmsh2opensees (third-party)

Helper functions to interface Gmsh with OpenSees, by José A. Abell M.
(2022). Original repository: <https://github.com/jaabell/gmsh2opensees>.

Included here because the analysis scripts use them. This code is **not**
covered by the MIT License of openBIMtoFEM: the original repository states
no license, and all rights remain with its author (see `NOTICE` at the
repository root).
